title: Fall Commencement
seo_title: Fall Commencement at Great Southern Bank Arena
description: Fall Commencement is Missouri State University's graduation ceremony, held in two sessions: the 10 a.m. ceremony covers the Darr College of Agriculture, College of Business, College of Natural and Applied Sciences, and Interdisciplinary Academic Programs, and the 1:30 p.m. ceremony covers the McQueary College of Health and Human Services, Reynolds College of Arts, Social Sciences, and Humanities, and College of Education. No ticket is required and there is no limit on guests per graduate; doors open 90 minutes before each ceremony, guests pass through security, and only clear bags are allowed. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026 at Great Southern Bank Arena in Springfield, MO, with designated parking, ADA seating on request, and a livestream of all ceremonies.
